title: Enterprise AI & Automation Briefing
summary: Enterprise AI news shifted from generic copilots toward governed production agents: IBM highlighted agentic software engineering inside Mashreq, SAP and ServiceNow pushed autonomous enterprise workflows, Cisco put agents inside collaboration, Atlassian opened team context to third-party agents, and Snowflake framed governed enterprise data as the control plane for agentic transformation.

stocks.name: International Business Machines Corporation
stocks.does: Provides hybrid cloud, enterprise software, consulting, infrastructure, automation, and AI platforms for large organizations.
stocks.briefing: IBM announced that Mashreq is piloting IBM Bob, its enterprise AI-powered software engineering platform, to accelerate integration design and troubleshooting across banking, payments, and enterprise systems, and separately expanded IBM Ready for SAP Solutions for AI-ready ERP modernization.

stocks.name: Mashreqbank PSC
stocks.does: Provides retail, corporate, investment, digital banking, payments, and wealth services in the United Arab Emirates and international markets.
stocks.briefing: Mashreq was the customer in IBM's October 12 announcement, piloting IBM Bob and running a secure gateway for roughly 4,000 AI-agent requests per month across digital banking, payments, and enterprise integration systems.

stocks.name: SAP SE
stocks.does: Provides enterprise resource planning, supply-chain, finance, procurement, human capital, analytics, data, and business AI software.
stocks.briefing: SAP used SAP Connect to showcase Joule Work, Joule Assistants, SAP Autonomous Suite, and Business AI Platform as the operating layer for the Autonomous Enterprise, with AI agents and assistants spanning core functions and supply-chain workflows.

stocks.name: ServiceNow, Inc.
stocks.does: Provides cloud workflow automation, IT service management, customer service, employee service, security operations, low-code development, and AI workflow products.
stocks.briefing: ServiceNow launched AI Workflow Factory and Autonomous Engineer, positioning its platform as a governed loop for discovering workflow improvements, building AI workflows, deploying them, and controlling agent actions through AI Control Tower.

stocks.name: Accenture plc
stocks.does: Provides consulting, systems integration, managed services, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and AI transformation services.
stocks.briefing: Accenture was cited in ServiceNow's AI Workflow Factory launch through its India ServiceNow business group, reinforcing consulting demand around governed AI automation across existing enterprise systems.

stocks.name: Infosys Limited
stocks.role: enterprise AI services and platform partner
stocks.does: Provides IT services, consulting, cloud, data, automation, cybersecurity, and AI transformation services globally.
stocks.briefing: Infosys was cited in ServiceNow's launch as combining AI Workflow Factory and Autonomous Engineer with Infosys Topaz and Infosys Cobalt to move customers from isolated AI projects to scalable intelligent systems.

stocks.name: Cisco Systems, Inc.
stocks.role: agentic collaboration and customer experience provider
stocks.does: Provides networking, security, collaboration, observability, contact-center, and enterprise infrastructure products.
stocks.briefing: Cisco unveiled Webex agentic collaboration updates that let teams invite agents into spaces, meetings, and calls for multi-step work, while also adding Dialog as an agentic harness for the Webex AI Agent platform.

stocks.name: Atlassian Corporation
stocks.role: enterprise teamwork context graph and agent platform
stocks.does: Provides Jira, Confluence, Loom, Rovo, service management, planning, developer collaboration, and enterprise teamwork software.
stocks.briefing: Atlassian's Team '26 Europe announcements emphasized Teamwork Graph, Rovo, Agentic Multiplayer Protocol, and third-party-agent participation so enterprise AI work can happen in shared, governed team workflows instead of isolated sessions.

stocks.name: Snowflake Inc.
stocks.does: Provides cloud data warehousing, data lake, analytics, data sharing, governance, and AI Data Cloud services.
stocks.briefing: Snowflake promoted Expedition 2026 around enterprise-wide agentic transformation, saying governed data, shared context, and production-grade controls are the foundation for connecting data, models, and agents at scale.

stocks.name: Microsoft Corporation
stocks.role: enterprise AI and productivity ecosystem provider
stocks.does: Provides cloud computing, productivity software, operating systems, business applications, cybersecurity, developer tools, and AI platforms.
stocks.briefing: Microsoft was materially tied to the week's enterprise-agent ecosystem through SAP and IBM ERP modernization work, Snowflake's Expedition agenda featuring Satya Nadella, and collaboration workflows where agents act across productivity artifacts such as PowerPoint.
